newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary maize futures mixed, wheat drifts.
newsitem.headline: Hungary maize futures mixed, wheat drifts.

text.p: Maize futures ended mixed on the Budapest Commodity Exchange, while wheat prices lacked direction, traders said.
"Maize for the July delivery is cheaper than either May or March," said Ferenc Kiss of Agrokont.
"Exports possibilities to the Czech Republic and Poland will run out by the end of May," he added.
July delivery maize futures ended at 18,800 forints, with May at 19,000 and March at 19,250.
Wheat futures were sluggish because the outlook for 1997 output would remain unclear until the snow had melted, he said.
Tuesday's total turnover was 249.2 million forints or 537 contracts, of which 300 were for maize.
Lot size is 20,000 kg for all contracts.
